name: Nederland – aansluitcapaciteit (kleinverbruik, geen capaciteitstarief)
assumed: Two things. (1) The connection size: 3×25 A — 3 × 230 V × 25 A = 17.25 kW — is the default this preset offers, not the household's own. The published ladder is 1×25 A = 5.75 kW, 1×35 A = 8.05 kW, 3×25 A = 17.25 kW, 3×35 A = 24.15 kW, 3×50 A = 34.5 kW, up to kleinverbruik's ceiling of 3×80 A = 55.2 kW; the site picks its own in the flow (D2 §6). (2) The tolerance, which is zero on purpose: a hoofdzekering is a gG fuse whose conventional non-fusing current is about 1.45 × In for up to an hour, so an honest tolerance could be far wider — but a wider tolerance is a wider gate, and leaning on half an hour of fuse patience is not what a hard limit is for (INV-15). Zero treats any excess as trip risk at once, which is the safe direction; the fuse curve of the actual hoofdzekering is what would replace it. That the Netherlands bills households no measured capacity component is HLD §8's NL row and is not assumed: the ACM's 4×5 model lands in 2028/29 and arrives here as a new version when it does (INV-52).

versions.assumed: See the file-level note: a default connection size and a deliberately zero tolerance.
